# embodied in

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:embodiedIn`](gmeow-embodiedIn.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/embodiedIn>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) to a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) that embodies it. Non-functional: an [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) may be embodied in many Manifestations (hardcover, paperback, EPUB). Inverse of [`gmeow:embodies`](gmeow-embodies.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) -> [`gmeow:Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for Expression-rooted traversal down to its editions — enumerating the hardcover, paperback, and EPUB Manifestations of one [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting this directly when modelling from the [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) up — prefer [`gmeow:embodies`](gmeow-embodies.md) and read this inverse — and avoid it for the [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) tier (that is [`gmeow:realizedThrough`](gmeow-realizedThrough.md)).

### How to use

- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:embodies`](gmeow-embodies.md) from each [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) and read [`gmeow:embodiedIn`](gmeow-embodiedIn.md) by inversion; reach for it explicitly only in Expression-rooted projections.
